# Third-party source reference

`cadcraft-main-0.15.1-upstream.zip` is the unmodified CADCraft source archive supplied for this project. It is included to make the integration audit reproducible. It has not been linked into the Android app or modified by AR CAD.

The upstream archive contains `LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`, `NOTICE` and attribution files. Preserve all upstream notices and review the `acadrust` MPL-2.0 notice before distributing a combined binary/source release.
